purpose: Representative researched extra Singapore transport 3D cutout sprites for SGRTTrafficInfo. Vehicle appearance is separate from map route identity.
limitations: These are generated fixed-view miniature illustrations, not photographs or interactive 3D models.
The icons identify a representative vehicle type and livery, not the exact unit serving a trip or a current advertising wrap.
The Singapore Cable Car fleet also includes differently coloured and themed conventional cabins and spherical chrome SkyOrb cabins; this asset represents a conventional red-accented cabin only.
Geometry, glazing, equipment and fine livery details are simplified for legibility at map size.
All source photos and publication pages were used as research or reference only and are not redistributed with the assets.
Model version is not exposed by the built-in ImageGen tool; no specific model version is claimed.
